history.text: Arbanon, the first Albanian state, formed around Kruja.
Rival Albanian principalities held the coast and the mountains.
The Kingdom of Albania emerged, giving the area a defined monarchical state structure.
An Albanian principality took shape in the south as Byzantine authority receded.
Skanderbeg united the Albanian lords at Lezhë to resist the Ottomans.
Semi-independent pashaliks at Shkodra, Janina and Berat ruled much of the land.
The League of Prizren pressed for Albanian autonomy within the empire.
Independence was declared at Vlora on 28 November.
